comment: cmd.c readchar_core() and rhack():3659-3671 witness under altmeta. After ESC, readchar_core() reads the next byte through pgetchar(), whose (char) result is EOF for 0377, so ESC 0377 becomes ESC: in parse() it takes rhack()'s ESC arm, and at the travel prompt it cancels getpos(). ESC ESC stays ESC, and a plain 0377 is the empty command, which rhack() answers with nhbell() and reset_cmd_vars(). ESC 0200 becomes the unbound M-^@ and ESC s becomes M-s, #sit.
